ask: mkae a thing to show whos paid jake yet
sentence: Shows who in the chat has paid back the person who covered a shared bill, with an equal share per person, a progress bar, and the amount still owed.
use_when: One person paid a shared cost and the group needs to see who has paid them back
Friends splitting a dinner, tickets or a trip want a simple paid or unpaid list
The payer wants to mark people as paid by cash, Venmo or other
People want to add a short note like paying later
dont_use_when: Several people paid different amounts and the group needs to work out who owes whom
The bill needs uneven shares or item-by-item splitting
A group wants to vote or collect choices rather than track payments
